items.t: Turbocharger failure
items.job: Replace turbocharger with new gaskets and coolant/oil lines

items.t: Low power and turbo underboost
items.job: Diagnose boost leak and replace wastegate parts or turbo outlet hose
items.note: If the turbo itself is bad, see the turbo failure cost.

items.t: Coolant leaks from the water pump, housings and turbo lines
items.job: Replace leaking coolant housing, turbo coolant line or water pump
items.note: RepairPal puts a water pump job at about $764 to $1,136; a housing or hose costs less.

items.t: PCV valve cover failure and whistling
items.job: Replace valve cover with built-in PCV valve

items.t: Power loss in very cold weather
items.job: Apply GM cold-weather bulletin (software and intake/PCV updates)
items.note: Often covered under warranty when the car was newer.

items.t: Oil leaks from the oil pan and engine seals
items.job: Reseal oil pan or replace leaking seal
items.note: AWD models take longer because the transfer case is in the way.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace failed sensor or part

items.t: Check engine light that keeps coming back
items.job: Replace EVAP purge or vent valve

items.t: Dead battery
items.job: Replace 12V battery and clean cable ends

items.t: Clogged catalytic converter
items.job: Replace catalytic converter

items.t: Bubbling paint
items.job: Refinish affected body panel
items.note: Price is per panel at a body shop.

items.t: A/C blows warm air
items.job: Leak test, repair and recharge A/C
items.note: Recharge alone is cheap; a compressor is the high end.

items.t: Front airbags may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Airbag module software reflash
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Sudden loss of power steering (recall)
items.job: Replace steering column assembly
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak from stop/start part (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace stop/start accumulator
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Front seat may come loose in a crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect seat weld and replace lower seat track
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Lap belt pretensioner may not lock (recall)
items.job: Replace both front lap belt pretensioners
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not inflate (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger front airbag
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Key can be removed out of Park (recall)
items.job: Replace key cylinder lock housing
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Block heater cord can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater cord
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Heated steering wheel bolt may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure steering wheel fastener
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Airbag module left in factory mode (recall)
items.job: Reprogram airbag module
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.

items.t: Front seat bolts may be missing (recall)
items.job: Install front seat bolts
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if the recall was not already done.
